title: About Sergei
text: Sergei Patrushev is an entry-level software developer with hands-on projects in web development, Python, data analysis, machine learning and AI applications. Skills listed in his portfolio include JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, SQL, Git, APIs, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, LLMs, RAG, AI agents, ETL pipelines and Azure.

title: Experience
text: Sergei is a Volunteer Mentor Reviewer at Code the Dream since January 2026, helping learners with programming, code reviews and debugging. He is a Quality Technician at Inteplast AmmTop since July 2024. He worked as an IT Technician at Computer World from December 2022 to July 2024, building and repairing PCs and troubleshooting hardware and software.

title: Portfolio assistant
text: The portfolio assistant uses Flask, Ollama qwen2.5:7b, FAISS retrieval and all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings. Its API accepts independent questions. The server does not store chat history. Answers are grounded in portfolio evidence and may be incorrect. The backend can be offline while the portfolio remains available.
